description: Bicycle and Pedestrian Counts (2013-2016) is a dataset listed in City of Calgary open data portal (data.calgary.ca), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Calgary. The bicycle count is one of the ways the Bicycle Program is monitoring and evaluating cycling data, in keeping with the Council approved Cycling Strategy. Pedestrian counts are included to monitor pathway traffic. Coverage: Calgary. The portal files it under the category Transportation/Transit. Its tags are bicycle, count, bike. The table has 31 columns. Attribution on the portal: City of Calgary. The portal shows 2018-03-02 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is see the terms of use on the portal (no named licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-calgary-ca-portal.
